verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a built-in AI layer, Ramp Intelligence and Ramp agents. These agents autonomously code expenses, approve safe items and escalate risky ones, scan for anomalies, collect receipts and draft memos, and parse uploaded contracts to auto-fill requests. That is real in-product delegation, but it is preconfigured background automation rather than an assistant the user directs with ad hoc tasks. The MCP/CLI channels connect external assistants and do not count as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: an in-product conversational assistant to which users can delegate arbitrary tasks, detailed docs on how users assign and configure agent tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
